ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 60% high-intensity pixels (lateral lobes) to 40% low-intensity pixels (central fluke and trailing edge boundary).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone extends from the peduncle to the trailing edge. High-intensity lateral lobes exhibit asymmetric dark mottling; the left lobe shows higher density of low-intensity spots compared to the right lobe. A continuous low-intensity band follows the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire visible trailing edge; pixel deviations estimated between 2-8 pixels from the mean edge trajectory.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge; trailing edge displays a sigmoidal curve with inner concavity transitioning to outer convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark, circular pixel clusters located at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel, low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) are visible on the high-intensity region of the left lobe.
